# asc_subnets (Data Source)

Fetches the list of subnets for a VPC from the ASC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all subnets for a given VPC
data "asc_subnets" "all" {
  vpc_name = "my-vpc"
}

# Output all subnet names
output "subnet_names" {
  description = "List of all subnet names in the VPC"
  value       = [for subnet in data.asc_subnets.all.subnets : subnet.name]
}

# Output all subnet IDs
output "subnet_ids" {
  description = "List of all subnet IDs in the VPC"
  value       = [for subnet in data.asc_subnets.all.subnets : subnet.id]
}

# Output count of subnets
output "subnet_count" {
  description = "Total number of subnets in the VPC"
  value       = length(data.asc_subnets.all.subnets)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_name` (String) The name of the VPC to list subnets for.

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) The list of subnets in the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) The CIDR range of the subnet.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the subnet.
- `last_error` (String) The last error encountered during CRUD of the subnet.
- `name` (String) The name of the subnet.
- `status` (String) The current status of the subnet.
- `tags` (Map of String) User defined tags attached to the subnet.
- `type` (String) The type of the subnet (public or private).
- `urn` (String) The uniform resource name of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the parent VPC.
